_: FROZEN INTENT CONTRACT. Digest pinned in docs/build1/FROZEN_INTENTS.json and enforced by tests/gate_ask_spine_contract_frozen.js. Editing any field here without moving the digest in the same commit turns that gate red. The executor reads this file; it contains no business truth of its own.
question: Which completed maintenance work does not have valid proof?

scope.not: canonical maintenance truth — this intent knows about work orders and nothing else
scope.property: server-derived from the authenticated operator session; never client-supplied

consequence_class_means: no maintenance domain mutation of any kind. A durable Ask Spine read receipt is required audit history, not an operational consequence.

candidate_predicate.principle: SQL narrows the population; the canonical Release 0 derivation classifies it. No proof predicate is re-implemented here.

lane_a.name: current governed completion integrity
lane_a.note: This canonical view IS the predicate. It derives from release_0_completion_proof_status — the same SQL function the deferred guard and the activation use. Build 1 adds a property filter and nothing else.

lane_b.name: pre-cutover unverified history
lane_b.note: The cutover inventory is the canonical record of what predates the activation. Membership is the discriminator, exactly as proof_state.deriveProofState uses it.

candidate_predicate.population: every work order in the authenticated property that can truthfully match. NOT a recent-N sample.
candidate_predicate.ordering: deterministic: status, then work_order_ref, then id

required_sources.why: answerability. Without an activation the canonical proof derivation cannot run, and the honest answer is that the source cannot answer — never zero.
the four-state verdict for each supporting record. This intent consumes it and never recomputes it.
lane A membership and total_matching, from the canonical DB validator.

optional_sources_note: None. No data source is invented merely to make the PARTIAL coverage state reachable in this intent's first version.

evidence_time_rules.principle: read time is not fact time. executed_at is when the query ran; evidence_as_of is when the world was observed.
basis_order: latest work_order_proof_evaluations.evaluated_at among the supporting records
latest work_order_progress.occurred_at among the supporting records
none — reported honestly as null with a basis of no_evidence_timestamp
evidence_time_rules.forbidden: substituting now() for a missing evidence timestamp

result_cap_note: This intent's cap, frozen here. PER LANE: current integrity and pre-cutover history are separately bounded lists, so a large history cannot crowd current failures off the page. It is NOT shared with any other intent — a shared constant would let one intent's cap change another's without either digest moving. Enforced in SQL and re-enforced in the service.
withheld_conclusions: who has authority to reopen it
whether a resident should be contacted
whether this is getting better or worse over time
withheld_conclusions_note: An actor on record is not a person at fault; an assigned technician is not the ultimate accountable human. Attributed context may render; blame may not.

renderer_contract.principle: the executor emits a conclusion code; the renderer turns codes and counts into operator language. No model output reaches operating truth.
renderer_contract.model_required_note: An explicitly resolved intent executes and renders deterministically even if every model endpoint is unavailable. Operating truth does not depend on model availability.
forbidden_in_output: free text authored by a model
any claim not derivable from the fields above
the internal state name legacy_indeterminate in outward-facing language
